sections.description: A complete, white-label loyalty and referral program for WooCommerce. Customers earn points on every purchase, redeem them for dollar-value discounts at checkout, and invite friends via unique referral codes. Includes a floating rewards widget, in-cart / checkout banners, a My Account rewards tab, 5 transactional emails, HPOS-compatible order handling, admin analytics with Chart.js, CSV import/export, direct WPLoyalty migration, and a credit-on-signup queue for pending customer balances. Fully theme-agnostic — every store-visible element is override-safe against aggressive theme CSS.
sections.changelog:
1.8.0

Added

  • Rewards on the Cart and Checkout blocks.

- A rewards panel shows the balance and its value, "Use my points" (in the store's own button text) or a specific amount, then what was applied, with Remove.

- The Checkout block also gets the "Have a referral code?" field.

- A "You'll earn N points" line shows on both blocks.

- Totals update in place through the Store API, with no page reload. Every amount is re-checked on the server.

- Rewards and friend-referral coupons show as the program name and "Friend referral discount" instead of their codes, on the blocks and the classic checkout. Filters: wcle_rewards_coupon_label, wcle_friend_coupon_label.

  • Loyalty Program → Health. One page that checks:

- WooCommerce, PHP, libsodium and the plugin's tables

- scheduled jobs (missing, overdue, or DISABLE_WP_CRON set)

- named locks, the My Account rewards page, and each email (including emails a theme overrides)

- signed updates, the webhook queue, Omnisend and multi-currency plugins

- cached balances against the ledger

Fix buttons reschedule missing jobs, flush permalinks and rebuild balances. A plain-text report can be copied for support.

  • "Bonus points expire too" setting (Redemption, on by default). When expiry is on, sign-up, first-order, review, birthday, social, email-list and referral rewards get the same expiry as purchase points. Manual adjustments, imports and restored redemptions never expire. The storefront wording always matches what's switched on. Filters: wcle_bonus_expires_at, wcle_is_bonus_context, wcle_expiry_text.
  • Multi-currency stores. An order in a currency other than the store's earns on its store-currency value. The rate comes from the wcle_order_amount_in_base_currency filter, else from Aelia, WPML/WCML, WOOCS or CURCY order data. With no rate, the order earns nothing and gets an order note saying so (wcle_currency_conversion_missing action). Refund clawbacks use the same conversion, and storefront estimates hide rather than guess.
  • Grouped products show "Earn up to N points" (wcle_grouped_badge_text).

Fixed

  • Block checkout data. The Store API data for the Cart and Checkout blocks (and the block checkout's referral code field) was never registered, because WooCommerce fires woocommerce_blocks_loaded before this plugin starts.
  • Friend discount. The friend discount for referred visitors now applies on any page with the Checkout block, not only the store's designated checkout page.
  • Settings defaults. A setting with no stored value now shows its default on the settings screen, so saving the page doesn't switch new options off.
  • Lifetime totals. My Account, the rewards widget and the admin count lifetime earned and redeemed the same way. Restored redemptions are not counted as earned or redeemed.
  • Expiry warnings. Expiry warnings cover expiring bonus points.
  • Webhook IDs. Upgrading existing webhooks to IDs and secrets can't produce two different IDs when two requests arrive at once. A delivery queued during the upgrade is still sent.
  • Import confirmation. Confirming an import preview is claimed with an atomic database write, so a double click can't import twice, even with a persistent object cache.

1.7.2

A bug-fix release: points maths, emails, block checkout, admin reports and integrations.

Fixed

  • Points

- Expiry only takes points the customer hasn't spent; spending uses the oldest points first. Before, a customer who had spent their points could end up below zero when they expired. Expiry warnings and the Rewards tab use the same figure.

- Turning points expiry off now stops it completely, including points already dated to expire.

- A refund after an order was moved out of Completed no longer takes the points back twice.

- A redemption deducts the discount the order actually got, not the coupon's face value (for example, when the cart shrank after rewards were applied).

- Completing an order again earns on what the customer kept after refunds.

- A cancelled order that is paid late is charged its redeemed points, like a failed one.

- The review bonus is paid once per product, not once per review.

- Campaign dates and birthdays follow the store's timezone. A 29 February birthday is honoured on 28 February in other years.

- Expiry works through every due batch instead of 100 a day.

- The daily expiry and coupon-cleanup jobs reschedule themselves if they go missing (site migrations, network-activated multisite).

  • Emails

- Points earned, welcome, redeemed and referral emails are sent through WooCommerce's email system, so they go out reliably, with background emailing on or off.

- Expiry warnings show the right dollar amount, send one email per customer, and keep working on large stores.

- Plain-text emails no longer show codes like $.

  • Storefront

- Block cart and checkout: the rewards endpoints work, totals refresh after redeeming, and referred visitors get their friend discount.

- Messages no longer show raw HTML.

- The "points you'll earn" preview and product badges respect excluded categories and campaign multipliers.

- The rewards slider can't pick an amount outside your balance or limits.

- The rewards widget works properly with a keyboard.

- My Account → Rewards history is paginated.

  • Admin and integrations

- Dashboard and lifetime totals no longer count restored points as new ones. A Clawed Back figure is added.

- The customer list and balances export scale to large stores; membership comes from the ledger.

- Webhooks send points in points and add a dollars field. Failed deliveries are retried. A webhook with no events ticked is kept as disabled instead of deleted.

- Omnisend: API errors are retried instead of dropping events, and the backfill status no longer gets stuck.

- CSV import maps columns by header, accepts ;-separated and old-Mac files, and warns at the 1,000-row limit. Exports open correctly in Excel (UTF-8 BOM).

- Uninstall on multisite cleans every site.

  • Safety

- Balance locks fall back to a lock row when the database has no named locks, instead of carrying on unlocked.

- A guest's friend coupon is tied to their email as soon as checkout knows it.

Changed

  • Declares compatibility with the WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • "Lifetime earned" includes bonuses, imports and manual credits.

1.7.1

A security release. Every store should update.

Security

  • Rewards coupons can no longer be stacked. Each customer has one current rewards coupon. Applying rewards again replaces it, a cart holds at most one, and its value is re-checked against the balance. An order that still carries two is put on hold with the coupons removed.
  • A failed payment no longer gives the points back for free. When a failed order is paid later (from My Account, say), the redeemed points are deducted again.
  • Two checkouts at once can't spend the same balance. Redemptions now lock the customer's balance while it's checked and debited.
  • Referral links can't be faked. The referral cookie is signed. Cookies set before this update are ignored, so those visitors need to use the link or code again.
  • First-order referral discounts are checked on the block checkout too. Typing a different email no longer makes a returning customer look new.
  • Referral and first-order rewards are taken back when the friend's order is refunded or cancelled. Friend discount coupons now expire after 7 days and can't be guessed.
  • Imported and guest balances need an email confirmation. A balance waiting for an email address (from an import, the WPLoyalty migration or a guest order) is credited only after the account clicks the "Collect my rewards" link sent to that address. The Rewards tab shows what's waiting, with a Resend button. Filter: wcle_pending_claim_requires_confirmation.
  • Updates are signed. Stores check each update's signature and checksum before installing it, and only accept downloads from the official releases page. Automatic updates stay on, and admins now see a notice saying so with a link to turn them off.
  • Webhooks: requests no longer follow redirects. Each webhook has a signing secret, and requests carry X-WCLE-Timestamp and X-WCLE-Signature headers. Saved auth headers are no longer shown in the admin.
  • Exports: cells that could run as spreadsheet formulas are neutralised.
  • Imports: a preview can only be processed once, point values are range-checked, and uploads over 20 MB are refused.
  • Admin:

- Only administrators can turn on "Remove all data on uninstall".

- Shop managers can't adjust or ban administrator accounts.

- Number settings and manual adjustments are range-checked.

Changed

  • The developer README is no longer included in the plugin zip; a short readme.txt replaces it.
  • Releases can be built and published from a Mac with bin/release-local.sh.
